scope: New integration contract using settled pinned API/codec facts. No implementation, source fetch, compilation, tests, runtime, MMIO/PTE code, SSH/boot/Signal or frozen-leaf edit.

settled_API_basis.no_rederivation_claim: The settled source facts and limitations remain unchanged; relevant current source hashes match that contract. Native79/control002 improve private allocation/control protection only, not exposure authority.

exact_virtual_signatures.iovmMapMemory: virtual IOReturn iovmMapMemory(IOMemoryDescriptor *memory, uint64_t descriptorOffset, uint64_t length, uint32_t mapOptions, const IODMAMapSpecification *mapSpecification, IODMACommand *dmaCommand, const IODMAMapPageList *pageList, uint64_t *mapAddress, uint64_t *mapLength) = 0;
exact_virtual_signatures.iovmUnmapMemory: virtual IOReturn iovmUnmapMemory(IOMemoryDescriptor *memory, IODMACommand *dmaCommand, uint64_t mapAddress, uint64_t mapLength) = 0;
exact_virtual_signatures.iovmInsert: virtual IOReturn iovmInsert(uint32_t options, uint64_t mapAddress, uint64_t offset, uint64_t physicalAddress, uint64_t length) = 0;

settled_API_basis.map_arguments: IOMapper byte extents/offsets are uint64_t; Read1/Write2/FullPageList0x100 differ from IODMACommand MappingOptions. The whole-buffer fast path zeroes a local mapSpec and preserves only accumulated alignment/numAddressBits, losing device/options; no pointer/type/name appearance substitutes for coordinator attribution.
settled_API_basis.no_general_alloc_free_virtual: There is no separate per-device alloc/free virtual here. Memory-null IOMapperIOVMAlloc/Free are system-global C wrappers using page numbers converted to bytes; Free/Insert ignore errors. A per-requester adapter must neither implement those as a bypass nor set gSystem/fIsSystem.

first_workload.profile: PROPOSED single-requester, single-whole-data-page finite admission; not an operational driver profile
first_workload.resources: One same-owner coordinator, one owned root page, leaf page and data page, each16KiB; data descriptor length16KiB, one bounded IOVA reservation and one map publication at most. Ring may use its32-byte prefix but never reduce mapped/backing extent to32B.
first_workload.limits: Precompute the entire operation chain, including failure containment/revoke and IRQ operations, strictly below32 BPL effects before starting. Existing host sample12 effects is an example, not the native worst-case budget. Refuse before a callback if remaining budget cannot cover the declared finite chain.
first_workload.not_continuous: c585 has32 cumulative effects, one pending ticket and permanent exposure retention. It cannot support continuous map/unmap/reuse, rolling histories or unlimited packet DMA. Exhaustion is a stop, not a reason to retire/reinitialize exposed owners, create another registry or clear history. A continuous mapper needs a separately designed/versioned lifecycle and bounded drain/reuse proofs.

same_owner_boundary: Only the forthcoming reviewed coordinator may bind an adapter instance to exact native allocation identity, generation, descriptor and IODMACommand identities, requester and DART domain. It must retain the actual native descriptor/preparation/control/table/IOVA records before publication. The adapter holds an internal owner reference, not a caller-minted BPL lease or copied registry.

No new raw CPU/PA view export, token.anchor cast, manager.jobs inspection, alternate registry or foreign descriptor acceptance. Native79 currently has no effect/owned-view bridge; this contract does not supply one. Until that bridge exists and is reviewed, all real map/unmap/translation success remains blocked.

Coordinator records one matching effect ticket before the engine may mutate table memory, publish TTBR/RID/stream state or invalidate; outcome follows the actual return. No nested begin while another ticket is pending. Reentry/concurrent callbacks refuse before work; allocation/preparation/blocking waits are outside short metadata locks and forbidden interrupt/gated contexts.

Internal borrowed backing use, if later admitted, executes only inside the same coordinator operation with actual references pinned and immutable scope; the IOMapper API never makes an unowned physical page a valid owner. Return/error and journal outcome are distinct.
IOVA_reservation_contract: Use only explicit T8103 TTBR0 aperture[0x00100000,0xbff00000),16KiB granule, excluding zero and the MSI page[0xffffc000,2^32). First workload reserves exactly16KiB with a monotonic/nonreused reservation identity tied to mapper/domain/RID/SID/native generation and exact descriptor+command. No C-system allocator fallback.

Validate byte arithmetic without overflow, request alignment and address width separately from physical36-bit checks. Intersect supported IOVA32 aperture with the caller effective width;0/64 require an explicitly source-bound unconstrained-width interpretation, never shift by64. First caller should pin32-bit DMA and16KiB alignment. Reject unrecognized width/alignment semantics rather than defaulting to success.

Only exact whole owned data descriptor, offset0 and length0x4000. Mapping record stores requested/permitted rights, chosen base/extent, opaque owner and stable strong refs. No fixed address, identity/bypass, arbitrary physical/device memory, external UPL, paging/subpage or reservation-only NULL-memory profile.

Publish mapAddress/mapLength together only after genuine table publication/order/invalidation completion, exact length0x4000. Preserve both caller outputs on refusal/failure. Oversized returned length is forbidden: IODMACommand interprets nonzero unequal allocation length as multisegment and invokes iovmInsert.

An IOVA can be cancelled before any possible effect only with known-private same-owner cleanup and correct native completion/retirement ordering. Any begun exposure effect permanently tombstones the reservation for this first workload, even a reported successful no-op or known later revoke. No general free/reuse is admitted.
permissions_and_attribution: Permissions are a nonempty exact subset of owned data rights (BPL/DLD Read1,Write2), consistent with the caller mapOptions; never silently promote READ to RW because a framework default requested it. Root/leaf/control pages never become data mappings. Physical page lies in verified original DRAM intervals, outside carveouts/protected controls/tables and below2^36.

For accepted full-page pageList form require pageOffset0/count1/actual prepared descriptor length0x4000 and source page identity equal to the coordinator-owned page. Copy ephemeral metadata into retained ordinary storage; do not retain the pageList pointer as ownership. Actual UPL entry ABI must be compiled/checked against real headers before implementation; zero-copy metadata or raw borrowed views are not authority.

IOMapperID is a provider-property association, not a SID. Publish a non-system mapper with the exact OSData identity matching the actual WLAN iommu-parent only after ownership/readiness. Bind hardware RID, per-port RID2SID slot and DART SID separately to the same owner; WLAN/BT grouping or another firmware stream cannot be inferred from the0x50 property.

mapSpec.device can be absent on XNU fast paths, so exact memory+command membership must already be registered internally. A supplied mismatching device, unregistered descriptor/command, stale generation or different RID/SID/domain is an error. An arbitrary IODMACommand object is not requester provenance.

Codec bindings/whole-graph validation prove canonical software format only. They do not discover a slot, establish stream/PCIe power ownership, clean caches or complete invalidation. Native79 and control002 prove no real mapping by themselves.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Validate actual guarded DART/port ownership, required tables/backing, page sizes and ready engine before returning true/publishing. Do not block indefinitely in copyMapperForDevice while holding publication locks.
callback_contract.present_engine: Must refuse start/publication now; prior hardware snapshot is PHY_NOT_READY. No fake engine success, P_PCIE_INIT, fIsSystem or global mapper-present manipulation.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Return0x4000 only for an admitted immutable T8103/CPU16KiB profile; this describes a granule, not mapping completion.
callback_contract.present_engine: A constant is not a reason to publish an otherwise unsupported service.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Exact profile/owner check, reservation, same-owner begin, real engine publication, real completion, then exact outputs+Success. Any uncertain publication quarantines and retains every possibly reachable resource; no subsequent remap/retry.
callback_contract.present_engine: Return a real NotReady/Unsupported/NotPermitted-class error as appropriate without outputs/side effects. No map success is supported by the present fake codec/models.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Only exact retained live record; same-owner journal before requester quiesce/revoke/cache visibility/bounded invalidate-complete. Success means revocation actually completed, not backing freed; first finite profile still retains BPL owner/backing/IOVA tombstone.
callback_contract.present_engine: No genuine drain/invalidation implementation exists; cannot return Success. Timeout/error must independently latch admission closed and retain native refs/preparation/policy/IOVA/table records because callers may discard errors and their handles.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Outside first whole-page profile; return real Unsupported, preserve state.
callback_contract.present_engine: Never implement successful no-op; current numeric PA argument supplies no ownership.

callback_contract.allowed_future_behavior: Only exact valid current owned immutable mapping with byte offset and permissions/context already admitted. Validated translation may return a PA; it grants no arbitrary physical read/write authority.
callback_contract.present_engine: uint64_t has no error channel. Returning0 or identity for invalid/unmapped/quarantined input is unsafe because IOMappedRead/Write dereference it. Keep non-system adapter off global wrappers and leave invalid-lookup containment/fail-stop behavior an explicit blocker before subclass admission; do not fabricate a success-shaped value.

source_basis: IOMemoryDescriptor.cpp3317 kIOMDDMAUnmap invokes dmaUnmap but returns Success.
dmaUnmap4895 decrements accounting before callback and updates accounting after it despite error.
IODMACommand::complete1057 clears allocation/address/length/prepared state after call; clearMemoryDescriptor later releases descriptor.
Descriptor/IOBuffer free may unmap without checking and then free storage.
unmap_error_retention.contract: Owner retention cannot depend on IODMACommand, descriptor DMA counters, unmap return propagation or base free. Boot-lifetime coordinator holds actual strong backing refs plus its exact explicit prepare pair independently before the first effect. Any incomplete drain, lost callback/result, failure or uncertainty keeps admission latched/quarantined, refs/table/IOVA/control/mapping record alive and requester disabled if a separately proved disable is available; never claim disable if unavailable.
unmap_error_retention.pair_rule: Do not call native complete/release/retire for exposed backing under private79 APIs. A future reviewed owner bridge must preserve exposure retention. Core private_retire does not release actual refs, and actual successful complete does not by itself authorize core retirement after exposure.
unmap_error_retention.free_stop_rule: No stop/free/unload/sleep/reset path may clear claims, reuse IOVA, release prepared backing or destroy control objects on mere service teardown. This finite first contract intentionally retains after verified revoke too; leak bounds are fixed and not a continuous service design.

present_blockers: Native79/public control002 have no owned exposure bridge; forthcoming coordinator contract/source must be independently admitted without field escape.

Actual DART reachability, shared port ownership, RID2SID/stream reservation, table visibility/order, invalidation acknowledgement, fault IRQ containment and requester drain are unimplemented/unobserved; existing PHY guard STOP stands.

No current real engine can make iovmMapMemory, iovmUnmapMemory or invalid mapToPhysicalAddress requests successful. Pure codec/fake mapping/host fixture success must not be repackaged as callback success.
Caller-swallowed unmap error and native strong-reference retention require a genuine lifetime bridge; a subclass returning Timeout alone is insufficient.
Continuous map/unmap/reuse exceeds frozen32-effect monotonic retention semantics and needs a new design, not an adapter workaround.
future_meaningful_tests: Same-owner host engine fixture: each mapping/table/state callback entered only under its own exact pending ticket/resource set; targeted late-begin mutation for mapping and each memory/state mutator; no callback on stale owner, duplicate RID/SID/slot or reentry. No alternate registry/native stand-in claim.

IOVA policy boundaries: zero/unaligned/MSI/aperture end/overflow,32-vs36-bit separation,width0/64 handling without shifts,requested alignment, full-page exact output extent; failing outputs unchanged and no reservation reuse after any begun effect.

Attribution: actual descriptor and IODMACommand pair mismatch, device omitted fast path vs mismatched supplied device, stale generation, wrong RID/SID/domain, foreign pageList/UPL, protection aliases and insufficient requested permissions all refuse.

Unmap failure source harness that intentionally discards the return exactly like XNU, clears command handles/releases its descriptor ref, then proves independently anchored actual refs/preparation/IOVA/tables survive and all future admission refuses. Do not use a Boolean owner or successful cleanup stub.

Fault every future callback before/after possible effect, unknown/nonreturn/stale completion, invalidation/drain timeout, requester activity and teardown races; prove no unsafe complete/free/reuse and bound total journal entries including containment below32.

Compile an original subclass+coordinator against exact real Kernel.framework C++ APIs and genuine C ABI, no test_sdk; inspect actual imports/export dependencies, IOMapper overrides/vtable signatures, per-function frames and module initialization. Host mocks do not prove allocator/UPL/physical ownership/hardware behavior.

Only after separately reviewed hardware admission: verify actual PA/backing/preparation, exclusive stream binding, cache/publication/invalidate/disable/drain completion with independent evidence; no hardware experiment is proposed by this design.
